title: Browser temperature lab
subtitle: Try a built-in sample or your own elevation map. Parameters and results stay in this experiment and do not change the world.

heightmap.title: Choose an elevation source
heightmap.start: A sample loads both the elevation map and its preset settings.
heightmap.drop: Choose or drop your own elevation map
heightmap.hint: PNG, JPEG, and WebP are supported. The image is resampled to 180 × 90. Grayscale values map to the elevation range in advanced settings.

action.loadingEngine: Loading and starting the browser runtime…

status.engineLoaded: Runtime ready. Reruns reuse it on this page. Initial load: {{seconds}} s.
status.previousResult: Showing the previous result. Recompute to apply the current settings.

view.title: Temperature field
view.placeholder: The first run may take longer while the browser loads the runtime. Once the result is ready, switch between annual and monthly maps without recalculating.

error.sample: The elevation sample could not load. Retry or choose your own elevation map.
error.file: This elevation map could not be read. Choose a valid PNG, JPEG, or WebP file.
error.runtime: The browser runtime could not start. Retry, or open the technical details if it still fails.
error.compute: The temperature calculation did not finish. Check your settings and retry.
error.params: Enter valid values and make sure the minimum elevation is below the maximum.

note: This preview uses a one-dimensional energy balance and a seasonal heat-capacity model. It does not calculate precipitation, winds, currents, or climate classes.
